FIX VERIFIED. .dense_double_matrix_bytes replaces the allocate-to-measure pattern and is exact - matched object.size on every shape I tried, including the 1x1 edge case:

  12x50000   helper 4800216   object.size 4800216   identical
  200x20000  helper 32000216  object.size 32000216  identical
  3x10       helper 456       object.size 456       identical
  1x1        helper 224       object.size 224       identical

The two per-feature-block object.size calls that sat inside the loop at :332-339 are gone, and the leg-operator walk at :239-241 now uses the same arithmetic. Three object.size calls remain: :271 (not in a loop), :344 (once per PARTITION, not per feature block, on a list of matrices whose size is not trivially computable - proportionate), and :631 (benchmark harness). All acceptable. Nothing further needed here.
